```{r}
#| label: libraries


library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("msigdbr")
```

## Analysis over time

```{r}
#| label: analysis expression over time

# import data from data folder
data_aug <- read.table("../data/data_aug")



# WIP: how many genes were expressed differently with significance
expression_stats <- data_aug |>
  # calculate diff to t=0
  group_by(tissue, ENTREZ_ID, source_name_ch1) |> 
  mutate(
    expression_0 = expression[timepoint == 0][1],
    diff_to_0 = expression - expression_0) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # make t-test
  group_by(tissue, timepoint, ENTREZ_ID) |>
  nest() |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    n = map_int(data, ~ sum(!is.na(.x$diff_to_0)))
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 2) |>
  mutate(
    test = map(data, ~ tidy(t.test(.x$diff_to_0, mu = 0)))
  ) |>
  unnest(test) |>
  group_by(tissue, timepoint) |>
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    is_sig = q_value < 0.05
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(tissue, timepoint, mean_log2fc = estimate, p.value, q_value, is_sig)




# TEMP SOLUTION: make random significance
expression_stats_random <- data_aug |> 
  mutate(is_sig = sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), 
                         nrow(data_aug), 
                         replace = TRUE,
                         prob = c(0.1, 0.9)))




# histogramm
expression_stats_random |> 
  filter(is_sig == TRUE) |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                       fill = tissue,
                       group = tissue)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 6,
                 position = "dodge",
                 colour = "black",
                 linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      brain = "red2", 
      intestine = "gold2",
      kidney = "darkolivegreen4",
      liver = "deepskyblue2",
      muscle = "darkorchid2")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 12, 24, 48, 72)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of genes with time",
    subtitle = "Genes with significantly different expression compared to t=0 (t-test, p > 0.05)",
    x = "timepoints [h]",
    y = "number of differentially expressed genes")
```

## Analysis heatmap

```{r}
#| label: Analysis heatmap

# Download the 50 hallmark pathways from mouse
hallmark_mm <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H") |>
  transmute(
    pathway = gs_name |>
      str_remove("^HALLMARK_") |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_title(),
    ENTREZ_ID = as.character(entrez_gene)
  ) |>
  distinct()

# new df with difference per gene over all samples
expression_stats_heat <- data_aug |> 
  mutate(ENTREZ_ID = as.character(ENTREZ_ID)) |> 
  group_by(ENTREZ_ID) |> 
  mutate(expression_diff = (expression - mean(expression))/sd(expression)) |> 
  inner_join(hallmark_mm, by = "ENTREZ_ID", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  ungroup()

# plot
expression_stats_heat |> 
  mutate(timepoint = as.factor(timepoint)) |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = timepoint,
                       y = sort_by(ENTREZ_ID, pathway),
                       fill = expression_diff)) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(~ tissue, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(midpoint = 0,
                        limits = c(-3, 3),
                        low = "blue",
                        mid = "white",
                        high = "red") +
    theme_classic()

expression_stats_heat |> 
  filter(ENTREZ_ID == "11303")
```
